description: This file contains helper functions for testing the behavior of the 'git read-tree' command under various conditions, including success and failure scenarios with dry-run options and working tree updates.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Tests that 'git read-tree' succeeds with given options, ensuring that the index remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Tests that 'git read-tree' fails with given options, validating the failure condition without altering the index.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Tests that 'git read-tree' succeeds and does not alter the working tree state when using the -u option.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Tests that 'git read-tree' fails and leaves the working tree unchanged when using the -u option, as expected.
